mapper.sql: id, order_id, amount, pay_date, note, created_by, create_time
mapper.select: select from jiedan_payment where order_id = #{orderId} order by pay_date desc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into jiedan_payment (order_id, amount, pay_date, note, created_by, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{amount}, #{payDate}, #{note}, #{createdBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from jiedan_payment where order_id = #{orderId}

select substr(p.pay_date, 1, 7) as month, sum(p.amount) as amount from jiedan_payment p join jiedan_order o on o.id = p.order_id where o.del_flag = 0 and p.pay_date >= #{fromDate} and o.owner_id = #{ownerId} group by substr(p.pay_date, 1, 7) order by month
select coalesce(sum(p.amount), 0) from jiedan_payment p join jiedan_order o on o.id = p.order_id where o.del_flag = 0 and o.owner_id = #{ownerId}
